contract_notes: The list operation is paginated and ordered with recent conversations first. Its default selects non-archived conversations; documented named scopes are unread, starred, archived and sent.
The show operation defaults auto_mark_as_read to true. Returned details include message ordering, participants and recursively forwarded content.
independent_receiver_scope: Explicit false propagation, unchanged unread/read/archived state, exact authored nested JSON and Unicode, default scope mapping, complete pagination or errors, real CLI and MCP stdio; synthetic loopback transport only.
fixture_limit: Not a Canvas emulator, live school receiving, browser/session-cookie qualification, attachment fetch, or proof of undocumented server semantics.
